page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: Actis.coque aliud diploma civitati dedit de tributo cerevisiario, fanxitque, ut id, quod ex Albani decreto agrarii soli tractarent, & in rem verterent suam, civitati esset cum ordinibus agri commune, eique erarium poneretur in urbe feris clausum duabus, penderetur in res communes parti utrique, ex voluntate & confensu conjun-cto : Atque hoc jure usa civitas est, quantum licuit, ad annum usque M. D. XCIIII, quo anno ad societatem foe-derisCroninga societati fœderis Belgici re-stituta, Ordinum Belgicorum, relictis partibus Hispanicis, restitutis & ad gubernacula locatis exulibus, magistratu priori exauctorato, rediit. Tum repetitis veteribus querelis ab agrariis, judicium de controversia Ordinibus generalibus integre permissum. page.notes: The note "Actis." is printed in a black-letter style; its reading is probable but uncertain. The word "conjun-cto" is set in italic with the final syllable in a cursive form that is hard to read; the reading "cto" is likely but should be checked. The margin note beside "fœderis" is a multi-line note; its breakdown into lines follows the scan. Right-hand edge shows a faint digitiser watermark, which is excluded.
